texts.li: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} sat up late comparing their Pokémon's moves and who'd learned what at which level. They filled two pages and argued over one of them.
{A_nameDef} showed {B_nameDef} a trick for keeping a Pokémon calm before a fight. {B_nameDef} showed {A_nameDef} a better one.
{A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} walked their Pokémon out to the edge of the land together and talked about what they'd catch next, if the colony ever has belts enough.
